NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.

FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This HTTP method is not allowed for this endpoint.
HTTP_ERROR: The request could not be completed.
INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again later.
REGISTERED: Account created. Please verify your phone number.
OTP_SENT: Verification code sent to your email successfully.

PHONE_EXISTS: This phone number is already registered.
COMMERCIAL_REG_EXISTS: This commercial registration number is already registered.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Phone number or password is incorrect.
ACCOUNT_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your phone number first.
ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Your account is suspended. Contact support.
ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
TOKEN_INVALID: The token is invalid or expired.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

DEAL_DELIVERED: Delivery confirmed. The inspection period has started.

LEDGER_UNBALANCED: The ledger entry is not balanced.
